decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is the most visible and heavily invested launch, presented on its own page in both years and fitting the firm's natural-care direction, so management will persist with it and attribute any weak sales to the ramp-up phase.

The hyaluronic serum has stayed on the website for two years and sits close to the core facial range, so it adds to the facial care direction at low cost, though its lower visibility makes it easier to drop than the flagship line.

The cleansing oil was launched only in 2024 and likely replaces the discontinued cleansing milk, so dropping it so soon would mean admitting a second failed cleanser, and management will give it more time.
